 The Geely Emgrand L EM-i plug-in hybrid sedan got a methanol-powered version in China with a starting price of 76,800 yuan (11,550 USD). Known domestically under the Geely Galaxy Starshine 6 EF name, it boasts a 4,806-mm body and up to 1,880 km of hybrid range.
 The regular version of the Geely Galaxy Starshine 6 was launched in China in October 2025 with a price range between 74,800 and 105,800 yuan (11,250 – 15,910 USD). According to China EV DataTracker , Geely handed over 24,970 units of the Starshine 6 to customers from January to September 2026 domestically. This vehicle is marketed under the Emgrand L EM-i name outside China.
 The Geely Galaxy Starshine 6 EF 
 On November 3, Geely launched the methanol-powered version of the Galaxy Starshine 6 called EF (E-Fuel). Its biggest highlight is the naturally aspirated 1.5-liter BHE15-BFDM four-cylinder with a peak power of 93 kW (125 hp). It adopts 350-bar direct fuel injection and an ignition energy of 120 mJ, allowing the ICE to work at minus 40 degrees Celsius. This engine offers a thermal efficiency of 48.15%. It can run on both fuel and methanol. Geely previously installed 1,400 methanol stations across China.
 Another highlight of the Geely Galaxy Starshine 6 EF is an electric motor with a peak power of 140 kW (188 hp). It transfers torque to the wheels via a 1-speed DHT gearbox. Two LFP battery options are available: 17 and 28.3 kWh. The car’s electric CLTC range lies between 130 and 230 km, depending on the powertrain version. It is around 107 – 189 km of WLTP range. The combined range of this sedan reaches 1,880 km on electricity and gasoline. The mixed range on methanol is 1,250 km CLTC.
 Interior & powertrain of the Geely Galaxy Starshine 6 EF 
 According to Geely officials, the Starshine 6 EF has a methanol consumption of 6.7 liters per 100 km. With a methanol price of 2.9 yuan (0.44 USD) per liter in China, this sedan costs around 20 yuan (3 USD) per 100 km to run on methanol. The brand’s representatives highlighted that driving a methanol-powered car allows a Chinese customer to save up to 30,000 yuan (4,510 USD) over 100,000 km. This model can run on both methanol and gasoline, with these two fuel types mixed in any proportion in the same 70-liter tank.
 The dimensions of the Geely Galaxy Starshine 6 EF are 4806/1886/1490 mm with a wheelbase of 2,756 mm. The car’s interior adopts a 14.6-inch touchscreen complemented by a 10.25-inch LCD instrument cluster. This model also offers a 609-liter trunk and 6 speakers.
 The price range of the Geely Galaxy Starshine 6 EF lies between 86,800 and 106,800 yuan (13,055 – 16,065 USD) before discounts. The limited-time discounts allow the price to be lowered to 76,800 – 96,800 yuan (11,550 – 14,560 USD).
 Update (November 4): Bearing in mind the Starshine 6 EF’s fuel consumption, it costs around 20 yuan (3 USD) per 100 km to run on methanol. Methanol and gasoline can be mixed in any proportion in the same tank. The mixed range of the Starshine 6 EF on methanol is 1,250 km under CLTC conditions.
